description: Wire format for $skillname prompt expansion, shared by nac-core (crates/nac-core/src/commands.rs) and the web frontend (crates/nac-server/web/src/app/lib/format.ts). An expanded prompt is {raw}{separator}{blocks}\n{close} where each block is one <skill_content name="...">...</skill_content> rendering and blocks are joined by a single \n. Collapse truncates at the last separator, but only when the message ends with the close tag. Consumers: Rust test invoked_skills_wire_format_matches_the_shared_fixture in commands.rs (via env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR") + ../../fixtures), vitest suite (../../../fixtures relative to crates/nac-server/web). Every collapse vector must stay true under a stricter collapse that only fires on a well-formed appended block: expansion vectors use well-formed blocks, and no-collapse vectors must keep not collapsing.
